'''Jogan fruitcake''' was a dish made with [[Jogan fruit/Legends|jogan fruit]].

==Ingredients and layout==
[[File:JoganFruitCakeDroids-TCWs3BR2.png|thumb|left|180px|LEP servant droids decorate a jogan fruitcake.]]
The dish was named for its main ingredient, the [[Jogan fruit/Legends|jogan fruit]]. Each tier of the cake was topped with several small berries or fruits, with the addition of fresh, whole jogan fruit on the highest layer.

==History==
During a banquet in honor of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Aang/Legends|Aang]], a member of the [[Military Oversight Committee/Legends|Senate Military Oversight Committee]], jogan fruitcake was served. The dish was a favorite of the Senator's and it was hoped his enjoyment of it would aid in convincing him to support Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] diplomatic efforts in the war.<ref name="EP" />
